title: Arabic Dataset for LLM Safeguard Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to sensitive and controversial regional topics using a dual-perspective framework that contrasts governmental and opposition viewpoints to identify stance-based biases.

Prompting models with an Arab-region-specific dataset covering cultural preservation, social norms, and regional historical events, then automatically assessing the alignment of the responses with regional cultural values.
Testing models against general safety risks, including social stereotypes and unfair discrimination, using translated and culturally localized prompts.
